remarks: Welcome to 151 Woodward Avenue! A beautiful 4 bed, 3.5 bath Parkside home combining character, architectural detail, an extensively updated interior & exceptional location just one block from Delaware Park. Enter through the bright, tiled breezeway w seating & storage to a 1st floor, completely renovated w refinished HW floors, recessed lighting, new custom bannister, & revamped kitchen. The open floor plan features a beautifully modernized eat-in kitchen w massive island, cream-white soft-close cabinetry w crown, modern copper hardware & copper accents, granite counters, tile backsplash, exposed brick, farmhouse sink, SS appliances w Samsung hood & wine chiller. The formal dining room has multiple built-ins, original wall sconces, ornate wood wainscoting w/ dish rail & concealed storage cabinet, extensive woodwork & a new modern chandelier. The living room features beautiful HW floors, add'l original detail & a wood burning fireplace (NRTC). A convenient half bath is located off the kitchen, w/ a custom open built-in bookshelf door. Upstairs, the prominent, distinctive turret houses the primary bedroom, which features its own ensuite full bath. Another full bath serves the second floor, while the full walk up attic provides an abundance of add'l storage. The partially finished basement offers add'l storage, laundry, & full bath. Outside, the fully fenced yard features multiple cooking/dining areas, an expansive 30' x 31' concrete patio, updated wooden stockade fence ('22) & separately fenced pool area w new aluminium fence ('22). The heated Gunite 43' x 20' pool features depths from 3' to 9', new tile/concrete premiter ('23), & new filter.  Add'l outdoor features include a permanent hard line for the grill, OOUI gas pizza oven, rare attached 2 car garage w pwr opener, low maintenance vinyl siding, & young roof ('19.) A show stopping location w 350 acres of Olmsted-designed parkland right outside the door, Delaware Park & golf course, Buffalo Zoo, Frank Lloyd Wright's Martin House, Forest Lawn, Hoyt Lake, & numerous park recreational facilities are all within a short walking distance. Open houses Thur 10/15: 5-7p; Sat 10/17: 10a-12p; Sun 10/18: 1-3p.
